figures.finding: Czech actors' union is the Herecká asociace (HA), an independent professional and trade-union organisation of performers founded in 1994; one joins by the online application and an entry fee of CZK 250 (CZK 40 for pensioners and students), then dues of CZK 150 a month for theatre only or audiovisual only, CZK 300 for both, CZK 200 a year for students, pensioners and parents on maternity leave. Membership is not stated as a condition of engagement.
figures.applies: Czech Republic, performers; fees as published 2026-11-01.
